mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers immediate equity sell-offs due to anticipated rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering a negative sentiment shift that drives S&P 500 returns lower over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with concurrent HOUST and RSAFS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% MoM) signals overheating labor markets that prompt aggressive Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.0% monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction, triggering recession fears that depress S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO below 12-month MA by > 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained three-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer confidence and rising home demand, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive months of rising HOUST, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) trend over three consecutive months indicates expanding manufacturing capacity and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive months of rising INDPRO, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
